summary: Iteration 4 — Parallel EUR/RWF pricing + per-VOD MoMo unlock ALL PASS. Backend: 5/5 new pytest cases pass. (a) GET /api/shows/{premium-show-id} as non-admin non-premium (+250788555444) returns locked=true, unlockPrice='1.00', unlockCurrency='EUR', unlockPriceRwf='1000', videoUrl=null. (b) POST /api/billing/vod/{id}/momo {phone:'250794230137'} returns reference (vod-…), besoftTxId, status ∈ {pending,processing,success,failed}, amount=1000, currency='RWF'. Mongo db.vod_purchases record confirmed: method='mtn_momo', amount=1000, currency='RWF', besoftPayload.debit.metadata.kind='debit_credit' AND besoftPayload.debit.metadata.credits[0].payee_identifier='250798875272'. (c) GET /api/billing/vod/{id}/momo/{ref} returns {reference, status, amount, currency}. Invalid phone → 400. Unauth → 401. Frontend (mobile 390x844, non-admin +250788555444 signed in via OTP 123456): (i) /paywall shows BOTH prices: BASIC row '1€ / 1,000 RWF', PREMIUM row '3€ / 3,000 RWF' with hint 'Card charges in EUR · MoMo charges in RWF' on each card; TOTAL footer '3€ / 3,000 RWF'. (ii) YEARLY toggle → BASIC '10€ / 10,000 RWF', PREMIUM '30€ / 30,000 RWF', footer '30€ / 30,000 RWF'. (iii) /checkout with plan=premium_yearly: PayPal default shows '30.00 EUR' + note '≈ 30,000 RWF via Mobile Money'; switching to method=mtn_momo shows '30,000 RWF' + note '≈ 30.00 EUR via Card / PayPal'. (iv) /video/{premium-show-id} shows locked-box with buy-vod-btn 'PAY 1.00€ (CARD)' AND buy-vod-momo-btn '1,000 RWF (MoMo)'. Tapping MoMo reveals vod-momo-phone (TextInput) + vod-momo-confirm ('SEND MOMO REQUEST'). (v) Regression: home-admin correctly hidden for non-admin, 3 program cards visible, home-live-news opens live-news-screen (YouTube iframe).
